newsitem.title: UK: Cookson to buy U.S.-based GRP Inc.
newsitem.headline: Cookson to buy U.S.-based GRP Inc.

text.p: Britain's Cookson Group Plc said it agreed with a unit of France's Compagnie de Saint-Gobain to buy U.S.-based GRP Inc.
The industrial materials group said consideration for the acquisition, which was subject to approval by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission, would be determined at closing.

GRP, a division of Saint-Gobain's Carborundum Corp, based in Falconer, New York, had $53 million in sales in 1995 and a net asset value of $28.5 million at February 28, 1996, Cookson said in a statement on Friday.
The company said GRP, which produces fused cast refractory materials for the glass industry under the Monofrax trademark, would strengthen its advanced refractories business, Vesuvius.
